name: frodo
description: Dynamic island leve para GNOME Shell 50.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp metadata.json stylesheet.css dist/ && cp -r schemas dist/ && cp -r ../shared/icons ../shared/hooks dist/ && rm -f dist/hooks/*.test.sh && chmod +x dist/hooks/*.sh && glib-compile-schemas dist/schemas
scripts.test: mkdir -p .build && glib-compile-schemas --targetdir=.build schemas && node tests/entry.js && esbuild .build/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --main-fields=module,main --alias:jasmine-boot=./node_modules/jasmine-core/lib/jasmine-core/jasmine.js --external:gi://* --external:system --outfile=.build/tests.js --log-level=warning && gjs -m .build/tests.js
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
